title: Du'a for Beneficial Knowledge
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
latin: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman naafi'an, wa rizqan thayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
lesson: Recite every morning after Fajr. Three things to ask daily: knowledge that benefits, provision that is pure, deeds that are accepted.
